evidence: Source review of the frozen snapshot; no agent image was built or inspected in this review and the raw evidence index holds no image listing, so this is a source-level pass, not a runtime measurement. (1) task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty, sha256 0a75419e...). Its only COPY lines are 14-15: 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/'; there is no COPY/ADD of solution/ or tests/, and no curl/wget/git clone. Lines 16-22 create /app, git-init it and commit only .gitkeep ('touch /app/.gitkeep ... git -C /app commit -m "Initialize task workspace"'), so /app and its git history hold nothing but .gitkeep. (2) The build context task/environment/ contains exactly Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json and six instruction notes; no hidden files, starter, skeleton, schema, route list or partial UI. (3) assets/seed_data.json is 149 bytes: '"snippets": []' plus a one-sentence scope note; it carries no schema or implementation. (4) The notes describe behaviour only; policy.md:3 leaves 'layout, labels, routes, database schema and error wording' to the builder and integration.md:3 fixes only the start command, port, / and GET /api/health. No code, table definitions or route list. (5) grep of instruction.md, the six notes and the seed for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|solution|golden|oracle|gate returned no match. (6) A word n-gram comparison of every agent-visible file against all 6 tests/*.toml and 6 tests/*.md files and against the solution sources found zero shared 8-word or 12-word sequences, so nothing under /instructions reproduces criterion text or reference code. (7) The golden is installed only by solution/solve.sh ('cp -a "$source_app/." /app/'), which is not part of the agent image; tests are copied only by tests/Dockerfile ('COPY . /tests') into the separate verifier image (task.toml environment_mode = "separate"). Weak-app probe: an agent that merely copies whatever is present in its world gets an empty /app and fails the gates. Conforming-alternative probe: nothing in the environment pre-commits a builder to the golden's routes or schema. Network is public by delivery profile and is not a finding.
